audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0], [1] and [3] read "Skill" while win[0], win[1] and win[3] read "Lux" — the page answered "who wins Level 1" two different ways. Rows 2, 4, 5 and 6 already agree.
audit.why: Lucent Singularity reaches 1100 and Light Binding 1175 against Blooming Burst's 800 and Tangle-Barbs' 1000, so Lux owns the levels before Neeko's root is online and again once Q is banked for the step-up.
audit.corrected: phases[0/1/3].side -> Lux with the whys rewritten to the ranges; the other four rows left alone.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly timed: 3-5, level 6, first item, late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to "sidestep it behind minions". Tangle-Barbs damages and roots everything it passes through and gets larger, faster and longer-rooting when it passes a champion or kills a unit — hiding behind the wave feeds it rather than stopping it.
audit.why: Riot text on Neeko's E, verbatim in the kit file.
audit.corrected: Dodge laterally out of the line; the cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) is the window to step up, and Pop Blossom needs 600 range.

audit.why: Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Pop Blossom 120/105/90s are the two clocks the lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with both, plus the range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Titles promised a shield-timing rule and a root-discipline rule; the bodies discussed neither.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their own titles with real cooldowns.

edits.before: E-poke from max range on her last-hits — the slow zone plus passive auto is your chip engine from level 1.
edits.after: E reaches 1100, her Blooming Burst only 800 — poke her last-hits and she has no answer at all at level 1.

edits.before: Q joins: the root threat re-prices every step she takes past the wave's midline.
edits.after: Q joins at 1175: the root re-prices every step she takes toward Tangle-Barbs range.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — E every wave contact. Bank Manaflow and hold Q for her aggression, not yours.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — E every contact and hold Q for her Tangle-Barbs step-up, not for your own poke.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. It governs your forward steps. - W Prismatic Barrier spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range and it passes through minions, growing as it goes — dodge sideways, never behind the wave. - Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s and needs 600 range. - Her Q reaches 800; your E reaches 1100. Live in that gap.

edits.before: The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs passes through minions and grows — dodge laterally, then commit inside its 12-to-10s downtime.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Prismatic Barrier is 12-to-10s — throw it as Tangle-Barbs leaves her hands, not after the root lands, and it also covers the Q bloom behind it.

edits.before: Neeko whiffs Tangle-Barbs (Root) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: A whiffed Tangle-Barbs leaves her 10+ seconds with no way to hold you.

edits.before: That is Neeko’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Her Q reaches 800 and her E 1000 — inside that, she trades on her terms.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Light Binding is a flat 10s — spent on poke it is not there for her step-up, and her 600-range leap only fails against a root.

edits.before: Neeko wins by landing Tangle-Barbs (Root), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Neeko wins by landing Tangle-Barbs through the wave, following with Blooming Burst, and closing to 600 for Pop Blossom.

edits.before: Root her on sight with Q before her E Tangle-Barbs can reach you
edits.after: Root her with Q at 1175 before her E Tangle-Barbs reaches its 1000

edits.before: Land E Tangle-Barbs first to set up her Q and R burst
edits.after: Thread E Tangle-Barbs through the wave to set up her Q and R burst

notes: spikes[1].text and content.mid both say Pop Blossom's preparation can be interrupted. The kit flags Pop Blossom as dash + hardCC but NOT as a channel, and Riot's text only says the preparation is hidden while disguised — I could not verify from the kits that CC cancels it, so I left both strings untouched rather than reinforce or delete the claim. Recorded in unverified. dosFull[0].d's 'sidestep it behind minions' was a real mechanical error and is fixed.
